title: Computational and Cytotoxicity Evaluation of Phyllanthus Urinaria-Derived Compounds as Potential Anti-Cervical Cancer Agents via HPV-16 E6 Oncoprotein Inhibition.
authors: Putra, Andi Darma; Safika, Safika; Fadilah, Fadilah; Nuryanto, Kartiwa Hadi; Rahman, Aldi Tamara; Syariatin, Lasmini; Darmawan, Naufal Syafiq; Cuandra, Kevin Nathaniel; Puspita, Firda; Purwoto, Gatot
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过同源建模、分子对接和MD模拟评估植物化合物抑制HPV-16 E6蛋白的潜力，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但对象为病毒癌蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cervical cancer remains one of the most lethal cancers affecting women, with infection by high-risk Human Papillomavirus (HR-HPV), especially HPV-16, recognized as a primary cause. Phyllanthus urinaria, a plant that grows in Indonesia, has demonstrated notable both antiviral and anticancer properties. This study aimed to investigate the potential of P. urinaria as both an antiviral and anti-cervical cancer agent. The HPV-16 E6 protein was modeled using homology modelling, with model accuracy verified through torsional angle assessment and identification of conserved regions. Molecular docking was performed to examine E6-p53 interactions. Fraction of n-hexane compounds of P. urinaria were further evaluated for their interaction with E6 by molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation. Additionally, in vitro cytotoxicity assays were conducted using HaCaT (normal keratinocyte) and HeLa (cervical cancer) cell lines. Compounds from P. urinaria were found to interact with E6 within conserved regions and these interactions were more stable conformationally than those observed for p53. In vitro assay demonstrated that P. urinaria exhibited moderate cytotoxicity against HeLa cells but had limited toxicity toward HaCaT cells. The n-hexane fraction of P. urinaria leaves exhibits anti-cervical cancer activity by inhibiting HPV-16 E6 and eliminating cervical cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌仍然是影响女性的最致命癌症之一，高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HR-HPV）感染，尤其是HPV-16，被认为是其主要病因。叶下珠（Phyllanthus urinaria）是一种生长在印度尼西亚的植物，已显示出显著的抗病毒和抗癌特性。本研究旨在探讨叶下珠作为抗病毒和抗宫颈癌药物的潜力。通过同源建模（homology modelling）对HPV-16 E6蛋白进行建模，并通过扭转角评估和保守区域识别验证模型准确性。进行分子对接（molecular docking）以检查E6-p53相互作用。进一步通过分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟评估叶下珠正己烷馏分化合物与E6的相互作用。此外，使用HaCaT（正常角质形成细胞）和HeLa（宫颈癌细胞）细胞系进行体外细胞毒性试验。发现叶下珠中的化合物在保守区域内与E6相互作用，并且这些相互作用在构象上比观察到的p53更稳定。体外试验表明，叶下珠对HeLa细胞表现出中等细胞毒性，但对HaCaT细胞的毒性有限。叶下珠叶子的正己烷馏分通过抑制HPV-16 E6和消除宫颈癌细胞表现出抗宫颈癌活性。
